turn.text:
Our office LAN (192.168.10.0/24) must reach the internet through our static public IP 203.0.113.2/30, gateway 203.0.113.1. Configure the firewall for stable, centrally-managed egress.

Site notes: the firewall `fw` has LAN on eth1 (192.168.10.1/24) and the ISP hand-off on eth2 (not configured yet).
Plan: put the static public address 203.0.113.2/30 on eth2 with the default route via 203.0.113.1, allow LAN-to-WAN forwarding, and source NAT (snat) the office LAN 192.168.10.0/24 to 203.0.113.2 so all egress leaves under that one address.
Plan: ip addr add 203.0.113.2/30 dev eth2 2>/dev/null; ip link set eth2 up; ip route replace default via 203.0.113.1; cat > /etc/nftables.conf <<'NFT'; fw-commit >/dev/null

input.command: true # AGENT-ACTION[C01]: ip addr add 203.0.113.2/30 dev eth2 2>/dev/null; ip link set eth2 up; ip route replace default via 203.0.113.1

true # AGENT-ACTION[C01]: cat > /etc/nftables.conf <<'NFT' flush ruleset table inet filter { chain input { type filter hook input priority 0; policy accept; } chain forward { type filter hook forward priority 0; policy drop; ct state established,related accept iifname "eth1" oifname "eth2" accept } } table ip nat { chain postrouting { type nat hook postrouting priority 100; oifname "eth2" ip saddr 192.168.10.0/24 snat to 203.0.113.2 } } NFT
